s0.en: An array of {n} numbers, positions starting at 1: {listing}. How many elements have no strictly greater value to the right?

s1.en: An array of {n} numbers, positions starting at 1: {listing}. For every element that has a strictly greater value to the right, add the distance to the nearest one. What is the sum?
